requirements.statement: The system shall provide a single consolidated view of financial position (cash, receivables, payables, net assets) across both the India parent entity and US subsidiary entity.
requirements.rationale: Founders currently reconcile two sets of books manually.

requirements.statement: The system shall derive compliance status (filed/pending/overdue) dynamically from actual transaction and filing data, not from hardcoded values.
requirements.rationale: Hardcoded statuses give false confidence.

requirements.statement: The system shall produce transfer pricing documentation sufficient to defend arm's-length pricing to both IRS and CBDT.
requirements.rationale: Transfer pricing audit risk for cross-border intercompany transactions.

requirements.statement: The system shall reduce the founder's time-to-file for each statutory obligation by providing filing-ready exports that match the target portal's schema.
requirements.rationale: Core value proposition over spreadsheets.

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a complete and immutable audit trail of all financial mutations for tax audit defense.
requirements.rationale: Indian tax audit u/s 44AB and US IRS record-keeping requirements.

requirements.statement: The system shall classify each revenue transaction by customer country and derive GST treatment: Export (0%), OIDAR (18%), or Domestic.
requirements.rationale: Incorrect classification causes GST liability errors.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate GSTR-1 Table 6A export data in GSTN-compliant JSON schema.
requirements.rationale: Current export is generic CSV, rejected by GSTN offline utility.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate GSTR-3B draft data in GSTN-compliant JSON schema.
requirements.rationale: Same as REQ-007.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate Form 24Q TDS salary data as a CSV file conforming to the NSDL/Traces e-filing format.
requirements.rationale: Button exists but no generation logic.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate Form 26Q TDS non-salary data as a CSV file conforming to the NSDL/Traces e-filing format.
requirements.rationale: Button exists but no handler.

requirements.statement: The system shall execute a batch payroll run that computes gross, deductions (PF, PT, TDS, ESI if applicable), and net pay for all active employees for a given month.
requirements.rationale: Run Payroll button is non-functional.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute ESI contributions (employee 0.75% + employer 3.25%) when ESI is enabled and employee gross salary is at or below the ESI wage ceiling.
requirements.rationale: ESI config exists but no calculation logic.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate EPF ECR (Electronic Challan-cum-Return) data in the format required by the EPFO portal.
requirements.rationale: PF ECR build button is disabled/no logic.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate Form 5472 data (reportable transactions of a 25% foreign-owned US corporation) with transaction-type mapping from the ledger.
requirements.rationale: Referenced but no generation.

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a general ledger with double-entry journal entries, supporting manual entry, auto-posting from payroll and transfer pricing, and period-end closing.
requirements.rationale: Core accounting. Manual CRUD exists but no auto-posting integration.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute ITC (Input Tax Credit) from purchase invoices and reconcile against GSTR-2B when available.
requirements.rationale: ITC calc exists for GSTR-3B but no GSTR-2B reconciliation.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a filing calendar that derives due dates from the entity's registration type and jurisdiction, and shows data-readiness status for each filing.
requirements.rationale: Compliance hub shows static items.

requirements.statement: The system shall track FIRC (Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate) status by matching incoming wire transfers against Stripe payouts or bank credits.
requirements.rationale: Currently static display.

requirements.statement: The system shall track ODI (Overseas Direct Investment) reporting status including UIN and Annual Performance Report filing.
requirements.rationale: Currently static display.

requirements.statement: The system shall support Sec 40(b) partner remuneration calculation using the 90%/60% book-profit formula and record it as a journal entry.
requirements.rationale: Calculation implemented; auto-posting to ledger needed.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate a transfer pricing export PDF containing the intercompany invoice, method justification, and comparable analysis.
requirements.rationale: Export PDF button has no handler.

requirements.statement: The system shall support invoice creation with line items, tax computation, and PDF generation.
requirements.rationale: Invoice types exist in types.ts; functional flow needed.

requirements.statement: The system shall support vendor management, bill recording, and payment run processing.
requirements.rationale: Types exist; functional flow needed.

requirements.statement: The system shall record foreign income entries with source country, income type, DTAA article, and withholding tax paid.
requirements.rationale: ForeignIncomeRecord type exists; no UI flow.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute US federal corporate tax estimate (21% flat rate) from US-entity P&L.
requirements.rationale: USTaxDraft type exists; calculation present.

requirements.statement: All PII fields (PAN, Aadhaar, bank account numbers) shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent.
requirements.rationale: Currently stored as plain text in localStorage.

requirements.statement: PII fields shall be masked in the UI (show last 4 digits only) unless the user explicitly requests unmasking.
requirements.rationale: Shoulder-surfing risk for PAN/Aadhaar.

requirements.statement: SQLite shall be the authoritative system of record; localStorage shall serve only as a read cache.
requirements.rationale: Architecture ambiguity between localStorage-first and SQLite golden path.

requirements.statement: All regulatory export files shall pass schema validation against the target portal's published format specification before being offered for download.
requirements.rationale: Generic CSV/TXT is rejected by portals.

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain an immutable, timestamped audit log of every financial data mutation (create, update, void) including actor identity.
requirements.rationale: Tax audit u/s 44AB and IRS record-keeping.

requirements.statement: API response time for ledger queries shall be < 500ms at the 95th percentile for up to 10,000 transactions.
requirements.rationale: Financial OS must be responsive for daily use.

requirements.statement: The system shall support automated daily backup of the SQLite database with a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 24 hours.
requirements.rationale: Financial data loss is unrecoverable.

requirements.statement: FX rates (USD/INR) shall be fetched from a reliable external source and cached with a maximum staleness of 4 hours during business hours.
requirements.rationale: Hardcoded 83.5 causes incorrect conversions.

requirements.statement: All financial calculations (TDS, PF, GST, transfer pricing) shall use decimal arithmetic with at least 2 decimal places and banker's rounding.
requirements.rationale: Floating-point errors in financial calculations are a known failure mode.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want to run monthly payroll in one click and download all outputs (salary slips, PF ECR, TDS summary) as a single archive.
requirements.rationale: Current flow requires visiting multiple screens.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want the compliance hub to show me what filings are due this month, which are data-ready, and which have blocking gaps.
requirements.rationale: Currently shows hardcoded items.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want to edit employee details (designation, salary, bank, tax regime) after initial creation.
requirements.rationale: Currently add-only; no edit capability.

requirements.statement: As a CA/accountant, I want to download filing-ready data in the exact format accepted by GSTN/Traces/IRS portals.
requirements.rationale: Currently generic TXT/CSV.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want to see real-time FIRC status (wires pending vs. received) derived from actual bank data.
requirements.rationale: Currently static display.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want the onboarding wizard to let me add and remove revenue channels and expense categories.
requirements.rationale: Add buttons have no handlers.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want the dashboard compliance traffic lights to reflect actual filing status, not hardcoded values.
requirements.rationale: False confidence from hardcoded green lights.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want to void (not delete) a ledger transaction with a reason, creating a reversing entry.
requirements.rationale: Append-only is correct but needs void capability.

requirements.statement: As a founder, I want the AI assistant to analyze an uploaded invoice for GST/TDS compliance issues.
requirements.rationale: analyzeInvoice() exists in geminiService but is never called from UI.

requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize transactions from Stripe via the Stripe API with pagination and customer expansion.
requirements.rationale: Implemented and working.

requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize bank transactions from Mercury Bank via the Mercury API.
requirements.rationale: Partial integration exists; feed sync not complete.

requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize MoR revenue data from Lemon Squeezy via their API.
requirements.rationale: Mentioned in brief but no integration exists.

requirements.statement: The system shall fetch USD/INR exchange rates from a public API (e.g., RBI reference rate, exchangeratesapi.io) with fallback to last known rate.
requirements.rationale: Hardcoded 83.5 is stale.

requirements.statement: GSTR-1/3B export files shall conform to GSTN offline utility JSON schema version as published by GSTN.
requirements.rationale: Generic CSV rejected by portal.

requirements.statement: Form 24Q/26Q export files shall conform to NSDL/Traces e-TDS return CSV format specification.
requirements.rationale: No generation logic exists.

requirements.statement: EPF ECR file shall conform to EPFO portal upload format.
requirements.rationale: ECR build not implemented.

requirements.statement: The system shall send email notifications via SMTP (Nodemailer) for payroll completion, filing reminders, and document issuance.
requirements.rationale: SMTP config exists; notification triggers not wired.

requirements.statement: The AI compliance assistant shall use the Gemini API (primary) with Claude API as fallback, passing structured financial context per query.
requirements.rationale: Both integrations exist; fallback chain not formalized.

requirements.statement: The system shall operate in a single-organisation mode (MVP) where one set of entity profiles is supported per deployment. Multi-tenant SaaS monetization is deferred to a future version gated by authentication completion; this requirement documents the current scope boundary explicitly so data model decisions do not preclude future per-org isolation.
requirements.rationale: Prevents accidental architectural lock-in while acknowledging the missing monetization model.

requirements.statement: The MVP filing priority order shall be: (1) GSTR-1/3B JSON, (2) Form 24Q CSV, (3) Form 5472 data, (4) EPF ECR. All other regulatory formats (26Q, GSTR-9, 1120) are deferred to v2. Each deferred item shall render a clearly labelled 'Coming soon' state rather than a broken button.
requirements.rationale: Establishes an explicit shipping sequence to avoid parallel development across all formats.

requirements.statement: Every filing-ready export shall include a machine-readable and human-visible disclaimer stating: 'This data is generated for review purposes. The user is solely responsible for verifying accuracy before submission to any regulatory authority.' The disclaimer shall be embedded in export metadata and shown in the UI before download.
requirements.rationale: Establishes compliance ownership with the user, not the system. Reduces legal liability.

requirements.statement: The entity data model shall support exactly two entity slots (parent and subsidiary) with a type field of: India-LLP, India-PvtLtd, US-CCorp, US-LLC. Tax logic modules shall reference entity type, not hardcode LLP-specific rules, so that a Pvt Ltd parent can be onboarded without code changes.
requirements.rationale: Prevents structural hardcoding while keeping scope to a two-entity pair.

requirements.statement: The system shall differentiate from Zoho Books + CA by: (a) providing cross-entity consolidated view in one screen, (b) auto-classifying OIDAR/export/domestic from Stripe metadata, (c) generating filing-ready GSTN/Traces-schema exports rather than requiring manual reformatting. These three capabilities shall be demonstrable end-to-end on seeded data at every Gate review.
requirements.rationale: Anchors competitive differentiation as a verifiable demo requirement.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a three-way reconciliation view: (a) Stripe payouts vs. Mercury bank credits, (b) ledger balance vs. bank statement balance, (c) GSTR-2B ITC vs. purchase register ITC. Each pane shall show matched, unmatched, and disputed items.
requirements.rationale: Accountants will not trust the system without reconciliation.

requirements.statement: The payroll batch run shall validate all employees before processing. Validation failures (missing PAN, incomplete bank details, TDS regime not selected) shall halt that employee's row, produce an itemised error report, and continue processing remaining employees. The run shall never produce partial output silently.
requirements.rationale: Silent wrong payroll is worse than a halted payroll.

requirements.statement: The system shall support period-end closing: locking a fiscal month so no further journal entries can be posted against it, running auto-closing entries (transfer P&L to retained earnings at year-end), and displaying period status (open/closed/locked) in the ledger view.
requirements.rationale: Without period close, P&L and balance sheet are unreliable after year-end.

requirements.statement: The system shall accept transactions in any ISO 4217 currency and convert them to the entity's base currency (INR or USD) using the date-specific FX rate from REQ-033. Foreign-currency amounts shall be stored in both original and base-currency values. Conversion differences shall post to a separate FX Gain/Loss ledger account.
requirements.rationale: Founders receive payments in GBP, EUR, AED — these cannot be silently ignored.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute TDS on vendor/contractor payments under the applicable section: 194C (contractors, 1%/2%), 194J (professionals, 10%), 194H (commission, 5%), 194I (rent, 10%/2%). TDS deducted shall auto-post to a TDS Payable account and feed into Form 26Q generation.
requirements.rationale: Vendor TDS obligations currently invisible; penalty risk.

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a fixed asset register with acquisition cost, depreciation method (SLM/WDV), rate, accumulated depreciation, and net book value. Depreciation shall post automatically at period-end as a journal entry and feed into book profit computation for Sec 44AB.
requirements.rationale: Book profit without depreciation is incorrect for tax audit.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute advance tax liability in four instalments (June 15: 15%, Sept 15: 45%, Dec 15: 75%, March 15: 100%) based on estimated annual tax and record each instalment payment. It shall display Sec 234B/234C interest for any shortfall.
requirements.rationale: Founders miss advance tax deadlines without this tracking.

requirements.statement: The system shall support CSV/Excel import of historical transactions (ledger entries, invoices, employees) via a template file. Import shall validate against the domain schema, report row-level errors, and allow partial import of valid rows with a conflict report for invalid ones.
requirements.rationale: Founders with existing Tally/Zoho/spreadsheet books need a migration path.

requirements.statement: Latency SLOs: (a) ledger query (up to 10,000 rows): p95 < 500ms. (b) payroll batch (up to 50 employees): < 5s total. (c) compliance export generation: < 10s. (d) Stripe sync (up to 500 transactions): < 30s. (e) AI assistant response: < 8s p95. All measured at the API boundary, not the browser.
requirements.rationale: Establishes measurable performance targets for each critical operation.

requirements.statement: RTO (Recovery Time Objective): the system shall be restorable to a working state within 4 hours of a complete failure using the last successful backup. RPO (Recovery Point Objective): maximum data loss shall not exceed 24 hours (daily backup per REQ-032).
requirements.rationale: Financial data is irreplaceable; defines the backup/restore investment level.

requirements.statement: Financial records shall be retained for the longest applicable period across jurisdictions: 8 years from the end of the relevant tax year (India GST u/s 36 CGST Act), 6 years (India IT Act Sec 128), 7 years (US IRS for Form 5472). The system shall archive records to cold storage at year+1 and surface a deletion-risk warning before any purge.
requirements.rationale: Regulatory data retention obligation; accidental purge creates audit exposure.

requirements.statement: The UI shall conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA for all primary user flows (dashboard, payroll run, compliance exports). Conformance shall be verified by the accessibility-engineer agent before each Gate review.
requirements.rationale: WCAG AA is the baseline for B2B SaaS and avoids legal exposure.

requirements.statement: The MVP shall be explicitly single-user (one active session at a time). The system shall document this constraint visibly in the UI. Concurrent session detection shall log a warning. Multi-user concurrency is a v2 gate blocked on authentication completion (REQ-U-001 resolution).
requirements.rationale: Makes the implicit constraint explicit; prevents false assumptions in testing.

requirements.statement: Dependency scanning (npm audit) shall run in CI on every push and fail the build on any high-severity CVE. A full penetration test against OWASP Top 10 shall be conducted before any public deployment. Security findings shall be tracked in risk_register.json.
requirements.rationale: Financial system handling PAN/Aadhaar/EIN with no security testing cadence is unacceptable.

requirements.statement: The system shall define three roles: Owner (full access), Accountant (read-only on all data, download exports), Employee (read own payslip only). Role assignment shall be stored per-organisation. All data-mutation endpoints shall check role before executing.
requirements.rationale: Without roles, salary and tax data are visible to anyone with access.

requirements.statement: The system shall support an Accountant invite flow: Owner generates a time-limited (72-hour) read-only access link, Accountant opens it to a read-only dashboard, can export all filing-ready data, but cannot create or modify records.
requirements.rationale: CA collaboration is blocked without an access mechanism.

requirements.statement: All primary screens (dashboard, compliance hub, payroll list, ledger) shall be responsive and usable on viewports from 375px wide (mobile) to 1920px (desktop). Interactive data entry (payroll run, journal entry) is desktop-only with a graceful read-only fallback on mobile.
requirements.rationale: Founders check compliance status on phone; data entry on mobile is acceptable as read-only.

requirements.statement: Every async operation (Stripe sync, export generation, payroll batch, AI assistant call) shall display: a loading indicator during processing, a success state with output details on completion, and a descriptive error state on failure naming the failing step and the remediation action. Errors shall never display raw stack traces to the user.
requirements.rationale: Silent failures destroy trust in a financial system.

requirements.statement: The onboarding wizard shall validate each identifier field on blur and before allowing progression to the next step: GSTIN (15-char alphanumeric with checksum), PAN (10-char with format regex), TAN (10-char), EIN (XX-XXXXXXX), LLPIN (AAA-NNNN). Invalid fields shall block progression with a specific inline error message naming the validation rule that failed.
requirements.rationale: Bad identifiers corrupt all downstream calculations and schema-validated exports.

requirements.statement: All external API calls (Stripe, Mercury, Gemini, Claude) shall implement exponential backoff with jitter: initial delay 1s, max delay 32s, max 5 retries. Rate-limit responses (HTTP 429) shall use the Retry-After header when provided. After exhausting retries the operation shall fail with a structured error surfaced per REQ-075.
requirements.rationale: Silent sync failure on rate-limit is a data integrity risk.

requirements.statement: The system shall handle Stripe webhooks for the events: payment_intent.succeeded, charge.refunded, and customer.subscription.updated. Each event shall be idempotently processed (deduplicated by event ID) and posted to the ledger within 60 seconds of receipt.
requirements.rationale: Pull-only sync creates delays; webhooks are the standard real-time mechanism.

requirements.statement: The system shall support manual CSV upload of Indian bank statements (standard format: date, description, debit, credit, balance) as the MVP path for India-side bank feed. Each uploaded statement row shall be matched against existing ledger entries. Unmatched rows shall be presented for manual categorisation. Direct bank API integration is deferred to v2.
requirements.rationale: Direct Indian bank API access requires account-aggregator licensing; CSV upload is the viable MVP path.

requirements.statement: The system shall not integrate directly with the GSTN API in MVP. GSTN filing status (LUT validity, GSTR-1 acknowledgement) shall be entered manually by the founder or CA and stored as a filing record. A 'Check on GSTN portal' deep-link shall be provided per filing type. GSTN API integration is a v2 item.
requirements.rationale: GSTN API requires ASP/GSP registration; out of scope for MVP.

requirements.statement: The system shall export the full general ledger and chart-of-accounts mapping in a Tally-compatible CSV format (voucher type, date, ledger name, debit, credit, narration) and a standard trial balance CSV. These exports shall allow a CA to import into Tally Prime without manual reformatting.
requirements.rationale: Most Indian CAs use Tally; this removes a critical adoption blocker.
